name: github_demo_publication_plan
description: Deterministic decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

verificationState.description: Upstream verification outcome. Only the literal value "passed" avoids a draft PR; any other value (or absence) is treated as blocked.

draft.description: True unless verificationState is exactly "passed"; whether the PR should be opened as a draft.

outcome.description: Echoes verificationState when it is a non-empty string, otherwise "blocked".
